title: QAOA attains the SK ground-state energy in the thermodynamic-first limit
main_claim: For the zero-field Gaussian SK model, lim_{p->inf} Q_p = P*: for every eps>0 there are a finite depth p and deterministic angles (independent of n and J) whose fixed-parameter thermodynamic QAOA energy per spin is at least P* - eps. This proves the BFMVZ eventual-Parisi-optimality conjecture. A corollary gives regular MaxCut in successive limits.

issues.description: The whole primary route depends on the companion's full-support theorem (E a(t,X_t)^2 = 1, E u^2 = t) and on its Finite Gaussian coefficients proposition. I checked the companion's proof of that proposition: the Bessel and shifted-product argument is sound and the dependence is not circular. However, the paper cites the companion by theorem numbers ('Theorem 1.1, Lemmas 2.1-2.2, Corollary 7.1, Proposition 7.2') that I could not match to the companion's labelled environments. This is a reference-integrity point only, not a mathematical gap. The independent positive-temperature appendix route (Lopatto full RSB) is offered as a backup.
issues.evidence: 'These are Theorem~1.1, Lemmas~2.1--2.2 and Corollary~7.1 of \cite{SKSupport2026}' ; companion labels are thm:full-support, lem:regularity, lem:diffusion, cor:value, prop:gaussian

coverage: Read in full: intro/statement, Sec. 2 (fixed-word transfer, pointed spaces, root-shift energy, Prop. energy edge decomposition, classical Gaussian sector), all of Sec. 3 (scalar input, Gaussian rooted realization, trigonometric approximation, color/type exclusion lemma, Prop. classical-near-optimum), most of Sec. 4 (elementary masked controls, helper contraction generators and the two exact commutator identities, orthogonal-quadratics lemma, top-path cut analysis, rank induction, proof of Thm. classical-synthesis energy bound), all of Sec. 5 (packet estimates, initialization split, selective zero-clock rotations, echo lemma, Gram/energy induction, visibility via analyticity), Sec. 6 assembly, Sec. 8 MaxCut corollary. Also read the companion's consequences.tex (Cor. value, Prop. finite Gaussian coefficients). I verified these by hand: error budgets (eps/4 + eps/8*2 + 2sqrt(pH) < 3eps/4; Prop. 3.x budget 5eps/6), E(F_N) = sum A_j B_{j+1} via first-chaos projection, the |eps_D| <= <N>/M edge decomposition, helper commutators [H_l,G_l] -> X_k B F, the diagonal path giving #K-neighbors/(D p_K) -> 1, the simple-path variance sum p_l^2/p_K, <e,l_r> = -i e^{-2gamma^2}, d_{0,r} = -2br e + 2b sqrt(1-r^2) l_r, the formal test point <v_Z,e> = i e^{-8b^2} and a = 4bz e^{-8b^2}, the synthesis energy bound 2eta+2sqrt(p_H), and the MaxCut eta/4 split. Not re-derived: the long smooth gate-calculus estimates (Lemmas sums/unitary-clt/commuting-substitution, Thm gate-calculus, roughly lines 400-1459 of 02-foundations.tex), the lower-formula response recursion in Sec. 4 (about lines 700-980), and the positive-temperature appendix (07).
